svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Control layers - the four enforcement layers, from hard to soft
svg.desc: The four enforcement layers named by agent-guardrails.md and by the harness-bootstrap quality gate, drawn as nested boxes around the model. Layer 1 is the settings.json permissions.deny list, which decides what the agent cannot see; it is a prefix match, so it is a speed bump rather than the gate. Layer 2 is the PreToolUse hooks that exit 2 and decide what the agent cannot do; protect-secrets, guard-main-commit, check-commit-msg, protect-adr and guard-agent-spawn block, while guard-agent-scope only advises because the Edit and Write payload names no calling seat. Between layer 2 and layer 3 sits a band that is enforced but is not one of the four named layers: the agent frontmatter, whose tools allowlist decides what the agent cannot reach and whose maxTurns is the circuit breaker. Layer 3 is the rules directory, led by agent-guardrails.md, which is advisory: it holds only if the model complies. Inside it is the agent body, also advisory, and at the core the model itself, whose effort setting is a throttle rather than a rein. Layer 4 sits below the nest: the review commands, slash review-changes and slash secret-scan, run on the model before a merge and catch what the earlier layers missed. A final band shows the runtime control: slash harness-toggle moves a rule, command or hook into the disabled directory and records the change in the committed disabled.json ledger, with the hard tier requiring a phrase the user types and agents never toggleable at all.
svg.text: Reining the agents - the four enforcement layers, hard outside, soft inside
A violation has to defeat every layer that applies. Outermost = enforced, the model gets no vote. Innermost = advisory.
LAYER 1 settings.json permissions.deny -> what it cannot SEE
Read(**/.env), *.pem, *.key, *.p12, id_rsa*, credentials.json, secrets/**, git push --force, git reset --hard, rm -rf,
plus the Restricted-data paths you name. Honest limit: prefix matches, defeated by re-ordering. Layer 2 is the gate.
LAYER 2 PreToolUse hooks, exit 2 -> what it cannot DO
protect-secrets, guard-main-commit, check-commit-msg, protect-adr, guard-agent-spawn block. 9 hooks ship in all.
guard-agent-scope only advises: the Edit/Write payload names no calling seat. eval 93/93 per hook flavour.
ALSO ENFORCED agent frontmatter - not one of the four, the same hardness
tools: allowlist -> what it cannot REACH. Reviewers get Read, Grep, Glob, Bash - never Edit or Write.
maxTurns -> the circuit breaker on a stuck agent: debugger 30, code-reviewer 25, history-tracker 10.
LAYER 3 .claude/rules/agent-guardrails.md -> ADVISORY
Behaviour layers 1 and 2 cannot express. It holds only if the model complies.
Loaded every session with 6 more unconditional rules; 9 more load only on a matching file touch.
SOFT the agent body / system prompt
The role, the scope, the procedure it is asked to follow. Still an instruction.
AGENT
the model. It gets a vote only inside the soft layers.
effort: a THROTTLE, not a rein - how hard it pulls, not where it can go
LAYER 4 review commands -> what still got through
/review-changes and /secret-scan before merge. Runs on the model, so it is a second pair of eyes, not a wall.
RUNTIME /harness-toggle + .claude/disabled.json - a control can be switched off, on the record
A rule or command moves to .claude/disabled/; a hook's settings.json registration is stored verbatim and restored in place.
HARD tier - protect-secrets, guard-agent-spawn, security-privacy, agent-guardrails, /review-changes - needs the exact
phrase typed by the user. SOFT tier needs an explicit yes. Agents are never toggleable at all.
A soft control becomes hard the moment you can express it as a file the harness checks.
enforced - the harness decides
advisory - the model decides
the model itself
artifact - file on disk
